title: act(): let React finish before you check

slides.say: React doesn't update the DOM the instant you set state. In tests, act makes sure the updates are applied before you check.
Wrap renders and interactions in await act, with an async function. React applies every queued update, then your assertions see the real result.

slides.text: Use the async form. The sync act() doesn't work in every case and will be removed.
slides.say: Use the awaited async version. The sync version doesn't work in every case, and React plans to remove it.

slides.text: React Testing Library wraps render and its helpers in act() for you.
slides.say: Good news: React Testing Library already wraps render and its helpers in act, and sets up the test environment. You rarely call it yourself.
